description:
Situated in the sought-after village of Hayton, this spacious detached barn conversion offers a fantastic living space. The property comprises a welcoming living room, dining room, study and a well-equipped kitchen, providing ample room for comfortable living. With four bedrooms, including an en-suite to the principal bedroom, and a family bathroom, this home is perfect for a growing family. Boasting oak and sandstone flooring, as well as exposed sandstone walls, the property exudes charm and character throughout. Outside, a generous lawned garden and garage provide additional space and convenience. The large garden room, currently used as a bar and games room, offers a versatile space for entertainment or relaxation. Conveniently located near the A69 arterial routes and public transport links, Hayton village offers a peaceful setting, Primary school, and Public House with easy access to amenities and nearby towns like Carlisle and Brampton. Explore village living at its finest in this charming property.

Directions Leave Carlisle on the A69 heading east towards Brampton. Take the second entrance into the village and turn right at the T junction the property is on the right-hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Underfloor heating in Living Room • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available.
